description: This file defines a Bluetooth driver class for Broadcom 43XX chips, including configuration, initialization, firmware loading, and MAC address management. It also provides C linkage functions for constructing and destructing the driver instance.

classes.name: Broadcom43XX
classes.description: A driver class for Broadcom 43XX Bluetooth chips, handling firmware loading, configuration, and communication.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Broadcom43XX driver, including port, firmware path, baud rate, MAC address, and other settings.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth chip, resets it, loads firmware, and sets up communication parameters.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Sends a reset command to the Bluetooth chip.

methods.name: FindFirmware
methods.description: Recursively searches for firmware files matching the chip name in the specified directory.

methods.name: LoadName
methods.description: Reads the local name of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: SetClock
methods.description: Sets the clock frequency of the Bluetooth chip.

methods.name: SetSpeed
methods.description: Configures the baud rate of the serial connection to the Bluetooth chip.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: Firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware into the Bluetooth chip from a specified directory.

methods.name: GetDeviceMAC
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the device's network interface.
